description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken Sharpshooter], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Neophyte Warrior Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Awoken Sharpshooter
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Neophyte Warrior Mode
description.text: Casts Hard Tackle after using a Water ability, grants [Water Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user after using two Water abilities
